messages:
sam: Hey @support, customer reports invoice spike vs dashboard — meter shows 48k tokens but invoice charge equals ~62k. They use SDK v1.4 streaming with stop signal. sample request_id: req_0a1b2c3d. Any quick checks?

maya: Can you paste their request payload and whether system messages or tool calls were used? Also which model/quantization?

sam: They used model "redwood-34b", SDK js 1.4.0, request included system prompt and a tool call to "search" via function call. Quick repro snippet:
```js
const res = await client.chat.stream({
  model: "redwood-34b",
  messages: [
    {role: "system", content: "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {role: "user", content: "Find docs about batching" }
  ],
  functions: [{name: "search", ...}],
  stop: ["\n\n"]
})
```

sam: SDK estimate shows ~2.4k tokens, server meter shows 48k tokens billed. The API response (completion) looked like ~2.3k on our side.

leo: Are they using client-side token estimator that ignores system messages injected by sidecar or tool preambles? Also streaming can cut off but charging still counts full generation upstream (KV cache tokens). Could be prefix injected by dedicated sidecar, e.g., "tool-called:search" meta.

metering-bot: Incident note: req_0a1b2c3d flagged - server side counted tool preamble of 14k tokens due to repeated tool chain calls.

maya: Can you reproduce with curl? Also grab the SDK "X-Client-Request-Id" header and the server metering_id from logs.

sam: Repro with curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
 -H "X-Client-Request-Id: req-repro-123" \
 -d '{
  "model":"redwood-34b",
  "messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"short prompt"}],
  "stream":true,
  "functions":[{"name":"search","schema":{}}]
 }'
```

sam: On curl I count ~800 tokens via open-source tokenizer but invoice still shows 12k.

leo: A few checks:
- Ensure SDK isn't trimming assistant messages when estimating.
- If function calls are used, we currently send tool preamble messages server-side (e.g., tool metadata) that SDK estimator ignores. We're working to make estimator include them.
- For streaming, client-side may stop reading but server completed generation because of pipeline buffering.

maya: Could you provide the meter logs? Start/complete events and metering_id. Also whether customer used Redwood Dedicated with a dedicated routing policy — dedicated can add prefix for routing.

sam: Attached logs snippet:
```
meter.start metering_id=m_abc123 request=req-repro-123 tokens=0
runtime.load model=redwood-34b seq=4096
invoke.tool name=search prompt_tokens=132 completion_tokens=14200
meter.record metering_id=m_abc123 prompt=152 completion=14200 total=14352
```

support-engineer-1: That's our problem — invoke.tool has large completion tokens. Looks like tool ended up generating lots of text into tool result cached and counted as completion tokens. Probably a bug in function handling that didn't truncate tool output to the "tool" result and instead forwarded full tool payload into the model multiple times.

leo: Workaround for customer: disable function calls or limit tool max_tokens until we patch. Also share their metering_id and invoice line so billing can apply credit if root cause confirmed.

sam: I'll ask customer to disable functions and repro; sharing metering_id m_abc123 and request ids. Thanks.

metering-bot: Note added to incident tracker INC-2026.
